'''Kor Gejalli''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Kor Gejalli system/Legends|Kor Gejalli system]], a part of the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' area in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. It was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Groth system/Legends|Groth]] and [[Kor Trinivii system/Legends|Kor Trinivii systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kor Gejalli served as the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the [[Gejalli]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]; however, at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Anjiliac]] clan defeated the Gejalli in a clan war and took over its holdings, including Kor Gejalli.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Gejalli was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-11.<ref name="TEA" />
